data.one_liner: A powerful API backend framework for Dart with HTTP server, routing, SQL translator, and DB adapters.
data.what_it_does: Bones_API provides a comprehensive backend framework for Dart featuring an integrated HTTP server, modular route handling, entity handlers, a built-in SQL translator, and database adapters. It also includes cron job scheduling, static file hosting with virtual aliases, and a command-line interface.
use_when: Building a backend API server in Dart
Needing built-in routing, entity management, and SQL/database adapters
Requiring scheduled background cron tasks and static file serving with aliases
avoid_when: Building frontend UI applications (it's a backend framework)
Looking for a minimalist routing-only package like shelf without extra framework layers
strengths: Comprehensive all-in-one framework including HTTP server, routing, and DB adapters
Built-in cron scheduler with IANA time zones and retries
Advanced static file server features with `.aliases` path mapping
weaknesses: Large dependency footprint due to covering server, database, and utilities
Less modular for developers who want to pick and choose individual micro-packages
data.setup_notes: Activate the CLI globally using 'dart pub global activate bones_api' and configure your API routes and server modules in code.
